name: wsrc_land8_ref

job.purpose: wsrc landing tile (die-placed; 8 lanes of acc_* -> registered bad / nb), ref_tile re-route: the closed hand-kit view 6c3ed996d fails child_lint (b) no M7 PG stripes, (f) 29 face pins blocked

benches.name: land8-model-positive
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && cd {SRC} && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_wsrc_land8 -o {RUN}/bench/positive rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_window_la/tb_wsrc_land8.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_window_la/recovered_ctl_m2/ot_dsrom_wsrc_land8.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_window_la/recovered_ctl_m2/ot_hdc_prefix.sv && vvp {RUN}/bench/positive 2>&1 | tee {RUN}/bench/positive.log; grep -q 'PASS LAND8' {RUN}/bench/positive.log

_note: pin-limited: 2,184 acc_* pins on S. M5 alone at 2 tracks is ~10.4 pins/um (needs ~210 um); the balanced placer alternates M3/M5 per pin at ~0.057 um (per-layer pitch 0.114 >= 2 tracks of either), so S fits 129.6 um; util ~39% (std 1,435 um2), the old 140.4 x 43.224 hand kit was 27%.
